report.summary: 4 UI tests timed out. The cause is the app, not the tests: `list_books` in `app/main.py` sleeps for a random 0–8 s, and the UI tests give up after 5 s. First remove or make deterministic that sleep. Then decide whether the 5 s UI timeout is still appropriate.

causes.title: Books listing sleeps a random 0-8s, so 5s UI timeouts fail intermittently
causes.explanation: `list_books` calls `time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))`. `/books` renders it, and so does the register-to-redirect flow, which lands on `/books`. A request takes longer than 5 s about 37% of the time (3/8), and the UI `fail_fast` fixture sets a 5000 ms default timeout. The `goto('/books')` calls time out while waiting for `load`. The register click times out while waiting for the navigation to `/books` to finish. A rerun could pass, so the outcome depends on chance. The delay looks like injected latency, not a deterministic product bug. It still needs fixing in the app, or the tests will keep failing at random.
evidence: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load"
Locator.click ... click action done - waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (register redirects to /books)
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from `list_books`, or make it configurable and off by default in tests. If the slowness is real, fix it in the app. Don't raise the test timeout to hide it. Rerunning the tests is only a temporary workaround.
